# Executable files (anything starting with `MZ`) allowed in the repository,
# by SHA-256, each with a reason. `cargo xtask check-testdata` fails on any
# other (#25). Test fixtures are generated at test time and never committed
# (`cargo xtask fixtures`), so this list is normally empty: real malware,
# antivirus test strings and third-party signed binaries are never allowed
# (docs/testing.md#fixtures). Add an entry only for a reviewed, generated,
# benign file that cannot be built at test time.
